subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official qwen provider/auth contract through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94419, or should this stay outside the official qwen plugin for now?
rationale: The implementation path is concrete, but adding a provider id, env var, auth choices, model defaults, and outbound hosts is a product/ownership decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept In Qwen Provider
options.body: Review/repair the linked PR and, once merge-ready, accept Token Plan as an official qwen provider surface.

options.title: Route Outside Official Qwen
options.body: Close or pause the linked PR and ask for Token Plan support to live as an external plugin until maintainer ownership is clearer.

options.title: Defer Pending More Demand
options.body: Keep the issue open but require more maintainer/user evidence before adding another official Alibaba provider contract.

recommendation.title: Accept In Qwen Provider
recommendation.body: Review/repair the linked PR and, once merge-ready, accept Token Plan as an official qwen provider surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the qwen/provider routing surfaces that this new provider would extend.
